leads.title: Anti-Discrimination Act 1977 (NSW)
leads.documents: NSW discrimination protections covering homosexuality, transgender status, marital/domestic status and HIV/AIDS status in work, education, goods/services, accommodation
leads.detail: Cited as Anti-Discrimination Act 1977; homosexuality added 1983, transgender status and HIV/AIDS status added 1996, marital/domestic status added 2008; vilification added 1993 repealed Aug 2018

leads.title: NSW birth certificate change of sex requirements - 1 July 2025 reform
leads.documents: Procedure to change sex on NSW birth certificate; surgery requirement removed, now application form + unrelated adult witness known 1 year + $73 fee; no limit on number of changes; 766 changes reported Sept 2025
leads.detail: Cited as: 1996 to 30 June 2025 required sexual reassignment surgery + $153 fee; from 1 July 2025 no surgery required; divorce requirement abolished June 2018

leads.title: High Court of Australia - NSW Registrar of Births, Deaths and Marriages v Norrie (April 2014)
leads.documents: Court ruling that Australian law allows registration of change of sex to 'non-specific' and does not require identifying as male or female on identity documents
leads.detail: Cited as April 2014 High Court ruling; case originated in NSW brought by Norrie May-Welby; no URL visible in text

leads.title: NSW Parliament lower house unanimous motion - October 2020
leads.documents: Non-binding bipartisan motion calling for human rights, dignity and respect for transgender individuals within NSW
leads.detail: Cited as October 2020 NSW Parliament lower house passed unanimously; no URL visible in text

leads.title: ABC News report November 2024 + NSW prisoner protocols
leads.documents: Documented incident of transgender person in male prison granted undisclosed settlement by NSW Government; documents NSW custodial housing rule since 1996
leads.detail: Outlet: ABC News November 2024; protocol detail: transgender individuals 'who have had sexual reassignment surgery' allowed to be housed in female prisons for protection since 1996

leads.title: Crimes Amendment (Publicly Threatening and Inciting Violence) Act 2018
leads.documents: Repealed vilification provisions in Anti-Discrimination Act 1977 and replaced with criminal threatening/inciting violence offence in Crimes Act 1900 with up to 3-year imprisonment
leads.detail: Cited as passed unanimously both houses, signed by Governor; in effect 13 August 2018 by proclamation 10 August 2018

leads.title: NSW conversion practices ban - passed 22 March 2024, in effect 4 April 2025
leads.documents: Criminal ban on conversion therapy practices in NSW with up to 5 years imprisonment, with limited religious/parental exemptions; sermon exception noted
leads.detail: Cited as bill passed both houses unamended 22 March 2024, upper house 22-4; effective 12 months after royal assent on 4 April 2025

leads.title: NSW Special Commission of Inquiry into LGBTIQ hate crimes
leads.documents: Government judicial inquiry into decades of LGBTIQ hate crimes; NSW Police called Dec 2022 to give evidence on 88 deaths of gay men between 1970-2000
leads.detail: Cited as formal announcement Nov 2021, commenced work Nov 2022 seeking information throughout NSW; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Operation Taradale - NSW Police investigation
leads.documents: 2010s police investigation into spate of gay bashings, hate crimes and murders in Sydney 1980s-1990s, many unsolved; questions police methods and homophobia
leads.detail: Cited as 'Operation Taradale' in 2010s; related context: 30 unsolved gay-hate murders late 1970s-late 1990s; no URL visible in text

leads.title: NSW Mental Health Act 2007, section 16
leads.documents: Explicit statutory statement that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses
leads.detail: Cited as section 16 of the NSW Mental Health Act 2007; no URL visible in text
